limitations: All scores are provisional browser judgments based on the supplied screenshots, chronological still-frame filmstrips and runtime report; no tools, source, prior ratings or other task state were inspected.

Corresponding normal, enlarged and transition variants are grouped under their settled screen or state family; distinct error, loading, selection, disclosure and persistence states are separately identified.
For each item, A is the mean of hierarchy, typography and surfaces; F is the mean of clarity, feedback and accessibility; overall is round(0.4A + 0.6F, 1), excluding null dimensions.
The authorized A>=9 and F>=9 threshold is not met: material coherence, room transitions, dense centered reading and several enlarged hierarchies remain below it.

No hard-gate failure is established by the supplied browser evidence; content extending outside a still viewport is not treated as unreachable when supplied scrolling and focus checks cover that state.
Runtime results are supplied evidence, not independently rerun observations; screenshots alone do not prove persistence, keyboard operation, reduced motion, export completion or functional targets.
Filmstrips show sampled visual continuity rather than video playback; their intervals do not establish frame rate, and timing judgments rely on the separate reported browser measurements.
The visible room changes primarily demonstrate crossfades between paintings; independent physical parallax or a continuous three-dimensional camera path is not established.
Physical iPhone/VoiceOver, native keyboard, tilt, haptics, actual OS sharing, native notifications and native performance remain deferred without browser-score deductions solely for those boundaries.
Successful voice capture, connected Circles behavior and real billing are not demonstrated; the represented browser fallback and simulated-plan states are graded on their actual evidence.
Synthetic forecasts, stress passages, source titles and fixture dates are not production-copy defects and do not establish predictive accuracy or source quality.
Novice-use outcomes and representative assistive-technology results are not supplied, so this evaluation does not certify exemplary end-to-end usability or a full/native 9/10.
topFixes: Refine room crossfades to remove conspicuous overlapping paintings while retaining the stable foreground orb.
Integrate Sky's rounded selector and floating utility surfaces more convincingly with painted furniture, lighting and contact shadows.
Improve dense centered explanations with shorter passage groups and clearer prompt, publisher, body and link hierarchy.
Reduce enlarged vertical padding around disclosure, profile, check-in and invitation content so related actions remain closer together.
Make scrolling cues explicit in long writing fields and the invitation URL inset.
Keep a concise Plus-benefit summary beside plan prices and provide direct browser focus/press evidence for room destination miniatures.
